prompt:
Use the year-ordered table in the image. It shows a ledger-style table with one Name column, several year columns in chronological order, strong horizontal rules, and minimal vertical separators. Use the chronological year columns to answer the row-specific time question. For Lion, compute the sum over the year range 2023-2024.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence requirement: set "evidence" to an array containing the ordered queried year-cell bounding boxes from the start year through the end year.
Answer format: set "answer" to the exact integer temporal result.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236],[488,180,600,236]],"answer":29}
